notes.purpose: jaxfne/streaming.py implements a memory-safe, chunked alternative to running a full jax.lax.scan over an entire STDP-plasticity Izhikevich-network simulation in one shot (module docstring, line 1). It exposes run_stdp_stream, which slices the total timestep range into fixed-duration chunks, jit-compiles one lax.scan per chunk shape, and returns downsampled Vm/spike trajectories plus per-chunk diagnostic summaries (finite checks, firing rate, mean weight) instead of materializing the full-resolution trajectory in memory. It is re-exported as part of jaxfne's public API (jaxfne/__init__.py:311,328) for long-duration STDP runs.
